source.title: TNoodle 0.11.3
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.3 is now available from [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)

The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.11.1:

* Fixed a bug that could result in the generation of incorrect FMC scrambles.
* Fonts are now embedded into the generated PDFs to ensure a more consistent look across platforms.
* Fixed a bug that resulted in an error messages when saving a PDF in Chrome. 

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)

translation.title: TNoodle 0.11.3
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.3 现已可在 [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles) 下载。

相比 TNoodle 0.11.1，有以下修改：

* 修复了可能生成错误最少步打乱的问题。
* 生成的 PDF 现在会嵌入字体，以便在不同平台上保持更一致的显示效果。
* 修复了在 Chrome 中保存 PDF 时出现报错的问题。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为：[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)
